stories.title: Quincy Hotels refreshes brand identity
stories.summary: Quincy Hotels has refreshed its brand identity in a project led by Melbourne design agency Studio Payne. The rebranding is aimed at signalling a new chapter for the hotel brand as it prepares for future growth and aligns with the evolving expectations of its guests.

Canadian Affair and American Affair reveal fresh brand identity
stories.summary: Tour operators Canadian Affair and American Affair have unveiled a refreshed brand identity, introducing new logos and a contemporary visual style. The rebrand is designed to better showcase the breadth of experiences available across North America while maintaining the values and expertise of the sister brands.

stories.title: Times New Woman typeface highlights gender-based violence
stories.summary: The Times New Woman typeface translates official data on gender-based murders in Spain into a visual reading experience defined by absence. Developed by MUY and Pablo Gámez, the project uses the slogan New times, same tragedy to address the persistence of violence against women in Spanish society.

stories.title: Roboto Studio unveils Flowhub brand identity
stories.summary: Roboto Studio has rebuilt the Flowhub brand identity around a single mark, one typeface, and a neon moss green color. The system covers the website and product interface for the company, which processes more than $4 billion in annual sales for specialty retailers across the United States.

stories.title: Pentagram designs modular branding for Parker Institute
stories.summary: Pentagram has rebranded the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy, shortening the name to two words and adopting a blunt tagline. The new modular system uses electric violet print and candid lab shots to connect academic labs, funders, and startups. The institute does not stop at early research.

stories.title: Allo is a free UI font with adjustable weight and roundness
stories.summary: Designer Josh Puckett has released Allo, an open-source variable typeface for screens and interfaces. Based on Inter, the font allows users to adjust weight, roundness, and optical size. It features a structure that controls stroke thickness and corner expression while maintaining a consistent character framework.

stories.title: Base Design gives Visa a brand refresh
stories.summary: Design agency Base Design has created a compact version of the Visa logo and a new typeface, Visa Sans, as part of a brand refresh. The agency aims to build on the company's equity while giving it a renewed sense of energy for a younger generation.

stories.summary: Adobe, Figma and Canva are strengthening their enterprise product lines as generative AI reshapes design workflows. Adobe introduced its Creative Agent at Adobe MAX, while Canva unveiled Canva AI 2.0. The companies are targeting business users as individual creators increasingly turn to conversational AI for simple tasks.

stories.summary: Canva has opened its Model Context Protocol server to all developers, aiming to become the design infrastructure for the internet. The company is betting that its specific design taste will outperform general AI models. It is currently positioning itself as the design layer beneath other software platforms.

stories.summary: Adobe has launched its Creative Agent across the Creative Cloud suite, intending to provide agentic workflows that give creatives more time for their craft. The update includes generative restyle and relight tools in Photoshop and a new colour mode for Premiere. The assistant is also available in beta.

stories.title: X introduces parental controls for teen accounts
stories.summary: X has launched six parental control options for teen accounts, including time limits and follower approval. The platform requires the teenager to consent to the oversight before parents can access these settings. The company says it is giving teens a say in the matter.

stories.summary: After 20 years of existence, X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see and interact with on the platform. stories.title: WhatsApp adds message scheduling
stories.summary: WhatsApp is rolling out a feature allowing users to schedule messages up to 14 days in advance. The tool supports texts, photos and videos in both individual and group chats. The company describes the addition as one of its most requested features for users who forget to send messages.

stories.title: Shakti Design Residency enters its third year
stories.summary: The Shakti Design Residency has launched its third annual programme, pairing international designers with Indian artisans and ateliers. Founder Shalini Misra started the initiative after finding that local craft was often overlooked in favour of imports. The residency aims to bridge the gap between design and craft.

stories.title: AD Design Show 2026 expands to three cities
stories.summary: Architectural Digest India has expanded its AD Design Show to Mumbai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. The event features immersive installations and creative showcases, with Pidilite serving as the title partner. The show aims to move design beyond static objects to create an experience for visitors in each city.

stories.title: A designer converts a neglected home into an atelier
stories.summary: Designer Anusha Shetty has transformed a 6,000-square-foot family home in Hyderabad into a luxury design studio. The building, which had been left unoccupied since 2023, now serves as the Anusha Shetty Designs Luxury Atelier. The studio features an open lawn and maintains an old-world jali gate.

stories.title: Honda reveals design sketches for its first India-made electric SUV
stories.summary: Honda has released design sketches for the ALPHA, its first electric SUV manufactured in India. Designed at the Honda Design Centre in Japan, the model features a sleek profile and contemporary proportions. The company plans to hold the global premiere for the vehicle in India on December 2.

stories.title: Honda teases front-end design of Alpha electric SUV
stories.summary: Honda has released a teaser of the front-end design for its upcoming Alpha electric SUV, highlighting the headlamp setup and LED daytime running lights. The model is scheduled for a global debut in India on December 2. It represents a key addition to the company's electric portfolio.

stories.title: Honda confirms December 2 premiere for Alpha electric SUV
stories.summary: Honda has confirmed the global premiere of its Alpha electric SUV for December 2. The production version follows the 0 Alpha prototype shown at the 2025 Japan Mobility Show. The vehicle is expected to go on sale in India in early 2027 as Honda's first electric car.

JSW Motors unveils new brand identity
stories.summary: JSW Motors has introduced a new logo and brand identity ahead of its December 3 launch. The design features two ascending forms within an ellipse, intended to represent unity and the intersection of technology and mobility. The company says the logo follows the golden ratio and wheel-inspired contours.

stories.title: Chariot AI launches 11 billion parameter model suite
stories.summary: Chariot AI has unveiled its Chariot-1 suite, featuring an 11 billion parameter mixture-of-experts model and text-to-speech capabilities. Developed under the IndiaAI Mission, the models are available in three sizes for use on devices ranging from smartphones to data centres. The suite also introduces a shared alphabet for Indian scripts.

stories.title: Starforge raises 6.6 million euro to mass-produce fusion reactors
stories.summary: Munich-based startup Starforge has raised 6.6 million euro in pre-seed funding to manufacture fusion reactors in factories. The company plans to move away from one-off projects by stamping out units on production lines. The round was co-led by AENU and First Momentum Ventures.

stories.title: Fusion startup Starforge targets factory-line reactor production
stories.summary: Starforge has raised 6.6 million euro to build 200 to 300 megawatt fusion reactors on production lines. The company aims to sell reactors to utilities, though experts note that the required cost-reduction curve for such a model is significantly steeper than current peer-reviewed estimates suggest.

Lute raises 20 million dollars for robotic touch AI
stories.summary: Physical AI company Lute has raised 20 million dollars across pre-seed and seed rounds. Founded in 2026, the firm focuses on developing touch-based AI for robots. The company is led by CEO Paweł Budzianowski, who previously managed conversational AI research and production at PolyAI.

stories.title: Emerald Battery Labs raises $1.1M for salt-based battery tech - Dealroom
Emerald Battery Labs raises 1.1 million dollars for sodium-ion tech
stories.summary: Seattle startup Emerald Battery Labs has raised nearly 1.1 million dollars to develop sodium-ion batteries. The company aims to use sodium as a cheaper, more abundant alternative to lithium. While sodium-ion batteries may offer longer lifespans, they currently require larger systems due to lower energy density.

stories.title: Elecbits in talks for 15 million dollar funding round
stories.summary: Electronics manufacturing startup Elecbits is reportedly negotiating a 12 to 15 million dollar funding round led by Xponentia Capital. The Gurugram-based company provides PCB design, assembly and component sourcing services. Existing investor Nexus Venture Partners is expected to participate in the potential deal.

stories.title: Elecbits discusses new funding with Xponentia Capital
stories.summary: Electronics design and manufacturing firm Elecbits is in discussions to raise up to 15 million dollars. The company, founded in 2019, offers an integrated platform for hardware development and prototyping. The round is expected to include participation from existing investors including Nexus Venture Partners.

stories.title: Design education and the feeling of powerlessness
stories.summary: Céline Semaan argues that design education must shift to show students they can make a difference in the face of planetary collapse. After teaching a workshop at the School of Visual Arts, she noted that students felt distraught and convinced of their own powerlessness regarding global systems.

stories.title: Canva cuts jobs while promising AI will not replace humans
stories.summary: Canva plans to cut or relocate up to 1200 roles following a year of slowed growth. Chief executive Melanie Perkins stated the firm needs to be refound, while insisting that human tasks will not be replaced by artificial intelligence. The company has 13 years of history.

stories.title: NITES calls for AI policy framework to protect IT workers
stories.summary: The Nascent Information Technology Employees Senate has urged the government to create a policy framework to protect tech workers from AI job displacement. The union body stated it supports industry advancement but wants to ensure the workforce is not left behind during the adoption of new technologies.

stories.title: Zoho and LinkedIn report on AI growth in Indian SMBs
stories.summary: Indian small businesses with in-house AI talent grew teams 5.2 percentage points faster in the first half of 2026. A new report finds that while AI helps these firms scale, only 6 percent of their total workforce currently possesses everyday AI skills. Growth has its limits.

stories.title: Canva restructure strategy draws attention
stories.summary: Canva announced a restructure affecting 1271 roles globally with little prior consultation. The company maintained its reputation by offering six months of pay, career coaching and a free MacBook to affected staff. It appears that goodwill can be purchased in the tech sector.

stories.title: What Canva understood about exits and why the rest of corporate Australia is lagging behind - HR Leader
Macy Grimshaw wins 2026 H&M Design Award
stories.summary: Central Saint Martins graduate Macy Grimshaw won the 2026 H&M Design Award, which returned after a six-year hiatus. Her collection, M, was selected by an international jury for its creativity and craftsmanship. The award focuses on innovation in design and construction.

stories.title: Ryan Munro named Young Achiever in Housing
stories.summary: Ryan Munro, a 26-year-old UX designer at Kingdom Housing Association, received the Young Achiever in Housing award at the Scotland Housing Awards 2026. Since joining the sector in March 2025, he has focused on digital tools for staff and online services for tenants.

stories.title: BubbaDesk collapses into administration
stories.summary: Co-working and childcare start-up BubbaDesk has entered administration owing at least $900,000. Founder Lauren Perrett cited failed sale attempts and tax changes as reasons for the collapse. The business previously boasted partnerships with major firms, including Canva, to allow parents to work beside their babies.
